attest-bad-sig.when: the compact signature does not verify under attestorPubKey(seq) with this chain's blockHash(citedHeight), **or is high-S** (R17): flip a byte; or sign with s un-normalised

attest-key-not-held.when: the wallet does not hold the key the command needs: sign for a seq registered by another node

attest-not-eligible.when: the record is EJECTED or WITHDRAWN (S4: PENDING, ELIGIBLE and DORMANT are pooled): feed an attestation of an ejected seq

attest-stale.when: citedHeight ≤ tip − REF_LAG − ATTEST_MAX_AGE, above the tip, or below startHeight: feed one citing tip − 20 on regtest

attest-unknown-seq.when: no Attestors record with that seq: yed_addattestation of an attestation signed for seq 999

bad-address.when: the address is not an s1…/sm… or ys1… address of this network (a yb… YED address, a Sprout address, nonsense), or its Sapling spending key is not in this wallet: pass a yed_getnewaddress result as from

bond-below-min.when: bondYec < the module's floor for a join in the next block (params.attest.bondMinZat, D-Q-30; 5 YEC on regtest with no vaults): register with 4

bond-locked.when: still a member, a frozen bond, or within BOND_MATURITY of leaving (the bond exit delay): withdraw right after registering

bond-spent.when: the bond outpoint is already spent (bondSpentHeight set): withdraw twice

bundle-insufficient.when: armed and fewer than M_SELECT of selected(R, selector) have a usable attestation in the pool; also a given bundleHex that fails BUNDLE-1 at R (the message ends with the BUNDLE-1 reason). Message grammar: bundle-insufficient: <count> of <selected> selected attestors have a fresh attestation; missing seq <a,b,…> — the GUI reads the two numbers. Provoke: arm, feed one attestor only

bundle-malformed.when: bundleHex is not "YA" ‖ 0x01 ‖ count ‖ count × 74 bytes (RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER)

cancel-cosign-malformed.when: a cosigs entry that is not 69 bytes of hex or does not recover over this intent's cancel; one whose key is not a current member of the attestor set: the entry is dropped

cancel-cosign-needed.when: fewer co-signatures of distinct current members than cancelsRequired (the cancel-limit design, CAN-2; RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER, before any transaction). Message grammar: cancel-cosign-needed: this cancel needs <n> co-signature(s) of distinct current members (cancelsRequired), <m> given: call it with no cosigs

cancel-cosign-not-member.when: a cosigs entry that is not 69 bytes of hex or does not recover over this intent's cancel; one whose key is not a current member of the attestor set: the entry is dropped

cancel-statement-claimable.when: the statement's price says the vault was claimable at the claim's refHeight (C4b): co-sign at the vault's underwaterAt − 1

carrier-record-failed.when: the carrier record could not be written to <datadir>/yellowback/carriers.dat, which is written **before** the carrier is committed (cf. DigiByte v9.26.7 38895edb): nothing was sent. A record whose commit then fails is removed again. Provoke with an unwritable <datadir>/yellowback

carrier-timeout.when: wait = true and the carrier did not confirm within -yellowbackcarriertimeout seconds (default 600, max 3600); the carrier stays outstanding and is swept once its window lapses

carrier-wait-busy.when: wait = true while half of -rpcthreads (at least one) wait=true calls are already waiting for a carrier (RPC_WALLET_ERROR, before any transaction): retry or pass wait = false

change-floor.when: no selection leaves YED change of 0 or ≥ MIN_OUTPUT (H2; a REDEEM or CLAIM burns a sub-dollar remainder instead, H4, so it reaches this only when even that is impossible): send cents − 50 from a single cents output. The message is structured and always has this shape: change-floor: <requested> cents cannot be sent from these coins without change below the $1.00 minimum output; nearest workable amounts: below <n\

claim-burn-above-max.when: maxBurnCents > 0 and the YED the claim burns (the vault's mintedCents at preflight; the exact burn, the debt plus any H4 sub-dollar remainder, at build) exceeds it (hardening H-9.3; RPC_WALLET_ERROR; nothing signed): pass maxBurnCents = 1

claim-not-underwater.when: RED-4 would fail at the reference snapshot (the price did not fall)

claim-not-yet.when: tip below the vault's appHeight (refHeight + 1 since IT-1; claimHeight for a vault minted before the in-term rule)

claim-out-below-min.when: minOutZat > 0 and what reaches the destination (the claimant intent: the collateral less the RED-5 residual, U-23; the exact collateralOut at build) is below it (RPC_WALLET_ERROR; nothing signed): pass minOutZat = collateralZat

claim-unconfirmed.when: the claim is still in the mempool (co-sign only a confirmed claim, design A-6)

collateral-above-max.when: maxCollateralZat > 0 and the collateral vout[0] the mint needs exceeds it — at preflight (before the carrier) and again when the MINT is built on the confirmed carrier (RPC_WALLET_ERROR; nothing signed): pass maxCollateralZat = 1

equivocation-guard.when: attest-signed.dat holds a signature for (seq, citedHeight) at a different price (S16): sign twice for one height at two prices, also across a restart. Since the cancel-limit review it is looked up **by key**: a signature at that height under any seq the key ever held counts (a member that left and rejoined with the same hot key; EQV-1 binds the key). Message grammar: equivocation-guard: seq <n> already signed <p₀> for height <h>, or equivocation-guard: this key already signed <p₀> for height <h> under seq <n>

expiring-too-soon.when: the index is far enough behind the chain that R + REF_WINDOW would expire the transaction at once, or the index has not reached startHeight + REF_LAG

fee-no-eligible-payee.when: E(refHeight) empty (FEE-0; not an error for the wallet, which omits the output): a refHeight below the first quote tag

index-below-start.when: the index is far enough behind the chain that R + REF_WINDOW would expire the transaction at once, or the index has not reached startHeight + REF_LAG

insufficient-yec.when: the wallet (or the named from address) cannot cover collateral + fees from confirmed, unlocked outputs or notes (YED never pays the network fee): yed_mint … <an empty s1… address>

insufficient-yed.when: wallet YED below the burn or amount (the spendable YED: tokens an own unconfirmed transaction spends do not count)

invalid-address.when: a string that is neither a YED, a transparent P2PKH nor a plain-YEC post-quantum address of this network

keypool-empty.when: no fresh key could be drawn (keypoolrefill); on 6.20.0 only the CReserveKey change paths can raise it (see yed_getnewaddress)

lock-below-min.when: lockBlocks < BOND_MIN_LOCK (0 since the bond exit delay: a negative lockBlocks), or the resulting bondLocktime ≥ LOCKTIME_THRESHOLD

mempool-check-failed:<verdict>.when: MempoolCheck returned the named RED verdict (K7); provoke with a redemption whose reference snapshot has no pClaim where the claim path is chosen (vault-claim-not-underwater)

mint-bad-lock.when: lockBlocks outside every class, or lockHeight + GRACE ≥ LOCKTIME_THRESHOLD

mint-supply-cap.when: the wallet's dry run of MINT-1..10 refused the built mint under MINT-6 (a mint raced it to the cap after the mintpol-cap gate; RPC_VERIFY_REJECTED); yellowback_void_mint.py shows the consensus verdict

mint-unsatisfiable.when: requiredZat > MAX_MONEY (K14): MAX_MINT cents at priceMicroUsd = PRICE_MIN

mint-vault-share.when: the wallet's dry run refused the built mint under MINT-6b (D-Q-23a): its debt exceeds max(maxVaultShareBps of the MINT-6 cap, vaultShareFloorCents) (params.supplyCap.maxVaultCents); silent while the cap is undefined (regtest's supplyCapBps 0), so provoke on a network parameter set with a cap (RPC_VERIFY_REJECTED)

mintpol-cap.when: MINTPOL-1, one per halt bit and the cap: mint before activation; with no quote tags in the windows; with the global ratio below GLOBAL_RATIO_HALT_BPS and the class's base ratio below RECAP_RATIO_BPS (W16, IT-5: only a class whose base ratio reaches it mints through a global-ratio halt — class C with the in-term parameter set; the message names the classes that can); with P_fast/P_slow diverging by more than DIVERGENCE_BPS; with -yellowbacksupplycapbps low and supply at the cap — counting the MINT payloads already in this node's mempool toward it (audit C-3; the message then says "after N cents of mints in the mempool"). W20, IT-5 (replacing H-10's class-A rule): above the cap only a class whose base ratio is at or over RECAP_RATIO_BPS mints (class C with the in-term parameter set); the message says whether it can. **Residual race:** MINT-6 is judged at inclusion against live totals, so a competing mint this node has not seen (or one paying more) can still land first and make a mint that passed the gate confirm VOID; the collateral is then released by yed_redeem at lockHeight, no YED is issued and the fee is not refunded. Keep well inside the headroom when the cap is nearly reached.

mintpol-unarmed.when: MINTPOL-1 for H-1: yed_getinfo.mintRequiresArmed is true and the reference height R is not ARMED, so the mint would confirm VOID with mint-halted-unarmed (MINT-4); provoke on regtest with -yellowbackmintrequiresarmed before arming

no-payout-address.when: the node has no payout key and so can emit no tag (no -yellowbackpayoutaddress and no P2PKH -mineraddress)

not-a-yellowback-address.when: the recipient is not a yb…/yt…/yr… address of this network: pass an s1…/sm… address

not-dormant.when: the record's status is not DORMANT: revive an ELIGIBLE attestor

not-equivocation.when: any EQV-1 condition fails — different seqs, different citedHeights, equal prices, a bad signature, a seq whose bond is spent or already frozen (P4-b), or a citedHeight whose hash is not in the index (two sides of a fork): report the same attestation twice

notice-not-underwater.when: collateralZat · pEmerg ≥ mintedCents · EMERGENCY_RATIO_BPS · COIN under this node's bundle, or the snapshot at R is not armed: notice on a healthy vault

notice-standing.when: a Notices record for the vault exists with tip − notice.height ≤ EMERGENCY_NOTICE_TTL (NOT-1's no-reset clause): post twice

price-required.when: no priceMicroUsd given and the guard holds no price of this key for the claim's refHeight

too-many-addresses.when: an empty array, or more than 100 addresses

too-many-coins.when: covering the YEC the transaction needs would take more than 400 plain YEC inputs or 75,000 estimated bytes of them even largest-first (the selector goes smallest-first and falls back to largest-first when that would cross either cap; cf. DigiByte v9.26.7 b54e3861). Message grammar: too-many-coins: covering <amount> YEC would take more than 400 coins (or 75000 bytes of inputs); combine small coins first by sending them to yourself, then retry: a wallet of 1,000 pool payouts of 0.00001 YEC funding a 0.005 YEC fee

too-many-inputs.when: more than 250 YED inputs / more than 20 Sapling notes would be spent: consolidate first

too-many-notes.when: more than 250 YED inputs / more than 20 Sapling notes would be spent: consolidate first

unlock-acknowledgement-missing.when: the third argument is not exactly I understand this burns YED

vault-locked.when: tip below the vault's ownerHeight (refHeight + 1 since IT-1; lockHeight for a VOID vault and a vault minted before the in-term rule)

vault-not-active.when: an unknown txid; a CLOSED or CLAIMED vault (a VOID vault is releasable by yed_redeem, L14); another wallet's vault

vault-not-found.when: an unknown txid; a CLOSED or CLAIMED vault (a VOID vault is releasable by yed_redeem, L14); another wallet's vault

vault-not-owned.when: an unknown txid; a CLOSED or CLAIMED vault (a VOID vault is releasable by yed_redeem, L14); another wallet's vault

vault-spend-pending.when: a transaction in this node's mempool already spends the vault (yed_getvault.spendPending; the message names its txid); checked before any coin is selected (cf. DigiByte v9.26.7 00136af6): yed_redeem twice before a block

vault-value-too-small.when: the vault does not cover the network fee (at the floor rate on the owner path) plus the enforcement fee (cannot happen for a vault MINT-5 accepted)

verdict-parent-not-tip.when: the block's parent is not the index tip and the block is not a rejected child of it (N12): pass the tip's grandparent

raisedBy: every signing command; on 6.20.0 also `yed_getnewaddress` and every fresh-key draw
wallet-locked.when: the wallet is encrypted and locked (walletpassphrase first); the stock EnsureWalletIsUnlocked message may precede it

yed-burn-refused.when: with -yellowback, a raw transaction that spends a Tokens outpoint of this wallet without a payload that reassigns it (no payload, or a TRANSFER that assigns nothing): pass allowyedburn = true to send it anyway

yellowback-unhealthy.when: the index is unhealthy (unhealthyReason follows); provoke with -yellowbacktestfault=storage:commit then any non-allow-listed command. Also the storage boundary of yed_addattestation and yed_buildbundle (audit A-3): a storage exception under either marks the index unhealthy and the call fails with yellowback-unhealthy: storage failure in AddAttestation: … / … in BuildBundle: …
